dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Huh, me? No, I'm a farmer. If you have any questions about crop cycles, planting schedules, harvesting techniques, and the like, be sure to hit me up!

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Here at the Collective of Plenty, we don't really have an official granary manager. Or, to put it another way, everyone's a manager.

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Whoever wants to take some food, well, they just need to have a word with Tonaca — she's in charge of planning and logistics.
